title: More than 200,000 Texans waiting for Medicaid approval amid application delays
summary: The Texas Tribune reported Sept. 10, 2026 that more than 200,000 Texans were waiting for Medicaid approval as application delays continued and enrollment declined. This release frames the development as a statewide Medicaid coverage-access delay and application backlog, with source-visible examples including pregnant applicants waiting for time-sensitive coverage decisions; SNAP is treated only as source context, not the Care Line event.
